must_identify.item: The kubelet is restarting the container because the liveness probe fails
The probe targets port 8081 while the app listens on 8080

notes: The investigator ran no commands and reported 'No problems detected' despite an active CrashLooping alert. Check whether the run failed or the agent lacked cluster access. A reviewer could reasonably class this as 'wrong', since it asserts no problem exists.
